citations.id: Pinned terrain retry and renderer invalidation

notes: A retry interval previously marked trails dirty even when all cached DEM samples were valid. It now marks trails dirty only when missing/null samples are actually removed for retry. Existing >5000ms cadence, render-driven scheduling, active DEM/style/terrain invalidations, valid zero heights, missing-height omission, aircraft/path updates,96-guide sampling and384-entry cache cap are retained. The unchanged original test failure was reproduced on exact clean base source by controlling only renderer performance.now at4999/5001; original assertions remain intact. Added tests isolate the renderer clock and cover repeated intervals, idle frames, mixed valid/missing samples, recovery, and source invalidations. GPU upload/query counts are deterministic harness evidence; no measured frame-rate or full browser/device compatibility improvement is claimed. No provider/network/data, rights, source admission, AI review credit, configuration, service activation or public deployment changes. Separate NBI metadata work uses disjoint source paths.
